enriched.title: Simple Past e Vocabulário sobre Problemas Técnicos
enriched.summary: A aula abordou o uso do Simple Past para descrever eventos passados e problemas técnicos no trabalho. Também foram explorados conflitos de VPN e vocabulário técnico relacionado.

vocabulary.definition: A Virtual Private Network is a service that encrypts your internet connection and hides your IP address.
examples: I had a big problem with my VPN.
You need to activate your VPN to access the intranet.

vocabulary.definition: A private network accessible only to an organization's staff.
examples: I need to activate my VPN when I connect to Microsoft’s intranet.

vocabulary.definition: To set up something, especially a computer system, for a particular purpose.
examples: I needed to configure a new VPN for my customer.

vocabulary.definition: Being in a state of opposition.
A unique string of numbers separated by periods that identifies each computer using the Internet Protocol to communicate over a network.

grammar.explanation: The Simple Past tense is used to describe actions or events that happened and were completed in the past.
rules: Add -ed to the base form of regular verbs (e.g., 'work' becomes 'worked').
Use the second form of irregular verbs (e.g., 'go' becomes 'went').
For negatives, use 'did not' + base verb (e.g., 'I did not work').
examples: I had a big problem with my VPN.
commonMistakes: Using the base form of the verb instead of the past form (e.g., 'He go to school' instead of 'He went to school').
Forgetting to add 'did not' for negative sentences.

practiceQuestions.question: Rewrite the sentence in the negative: 'I worked yesterday.'
practiceQuestions.explanation: In the Simple Past, negatives are formed using 'did not' + base verb.

practiceQuestions.question: Fill in the blank: 'I _______ (have) a problem with my VPN.'
practiceQuestions.explanation: The verb 'have' in the Simple Past becomes 'had'.

practiceQuestions.question: Choose the correct sentence: a) I configures my VPN. b) I configured my VPN.
practiceQuestions.explanation: Regular verbs in the Simple Past add -ed to the base form.

culturalNotes: VPNs are commonly used in workplaces to provide secure access to internal networks.
Technical vocabulary like 'VPN' and 'intranet' is essential for IT professionals.
studyTips: Practice forming sentences in the Simple Past using your daily routine.
Familiarize yourself with technical terms related to your profession to improve fluency in work-related contexts.
originalExamples: I will try to tell you how my day was. (Eu vou tentar te contar como foi meu dia.)
I had a big problem with my VPN. (Eu tive um grande problema com minha VPN.)
I need to activate my VPN when I connect to Microsoft’s intranet. (Eu preciso ativar minha VPN quando me conecto à intranet da Microsoft.)
But today, I needed to configure a new VPN for my customer. (Mas hoje, eu precisei configurar uma nova VPN para o meu cliente.)
The VPNs created conflicting IPs. (As VPNs criaram IPs conflitantes.)
So I didn’t work. (Então eu não trabalhei.)
